skill.name: create-pr
skill.description: Generate commit messages, pull request titles, and pull request bodies from local git changes and repository templates.
skill.summary: Create pull request content from local git diffs and repository templates.
skill.author: Cloud-Officer

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by markdown code fences, documented local git commands, /dev/null redirection, and PR body formatting prose. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, hidden network use, or malicious business logic was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Shell examples use command substitution and unquoted branch variable expansion, which can trigger conservative scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the commands local and hardcoded, and consider documenting that DEFAULT_BRANCH is derived only from git metadata.

remediation.issue: The skill reads repository PR templates with cat.
remediation.suggestion: State that only conventional .github pull request template paths are read and no arbitrary files should be requested.

content.value_statement: Preparing pull request text from many changed files can be slow and inconsistent. This skill reviews local git changes and creates a commit message, title, and template-aware PR body.
actual_capabilities: Reads the current git branch name before drafting pull request content.
Collects committed and staged git diff summaries for the active branch.
Reads common GitHub pull request template files when they exist.
Generates a one-line commit message and pull request title.
Fills a pull request body while preserving template checkbox items.
Uses the JIRA_TICKET environment value when the template includes a Jira section.
limitations: Requires a local git repository with accessible branch and diff information.
Does not create, push, or submit the pull request on a hosting service.
Depends on the available diff and template content for accuracy.
Only handles Jira ticket insertion from the JIRA_TICKET environment value.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Feature Pull Request
use_cases.description: Create a clear commit message, PR title, and summary from feature branch changes.

use_cases.title: Standardize Repository Templates
use_cases.description: Fill an existing pull request template while preserving required checkbox items and sections.

use_cases.title: Speed Up Review Handoffs
use_cases.description: Generate review-ready PR text that accounts for changed files and staged work.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Basic PR Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a ready-to-use pull request draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create pull request content for my current branch. Include a commit message, PR title, and PR body.

prompt_templates.title: Use Repository Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request that relies on the repository PR template.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create pull request content from my current branch and fill the repository pull request template exactly.

prompt_templates.title: Include Staged Changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request when both committed and staged changes matter.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create pull request content that covers committed and staged changes. Make sure the summary accounts for every changed file.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Jira-Aware PR
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for teams that use Jira ticket placeholders.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create pull request content for my current branch. If the template has a Jira section, use the configured Jira ticket value.

output_examples.input: A branch adds authentication validation and updates related tests.
output_examples.output: Commit message: Add authentication validation tests. PR title: Add validation coverage for authentication. PR body: Summary and checklist sections filled for review.

output_examples.input: A branch changes database migration handling and includes a repository PR template.
output_examples.output: Commit message: Update migration handling. PR title: Improve database migration flow. PR body: Template checkboxes preserved, migration notes included, and non-applicable sections omitted.

output_examples.input: A branch has staged documentation updates and committed API changes.
output_examples.output: Commit message: Update API docs and behavior. PR title: Update API behavior and documentation. PR body: Both staged and committed changes summarized for reviewers.

best_practices: Run quality checks before asking for final pull request content.
Review the generated summary against the changed file list before publishing.
Set JIRA_TICKET when your repository template requires a Jira ticket value.
anti_patterns: Do not use the generated text without checking technical accuracy.
Do not remove required template checkboxes after generation.
Do not ask the skill to submit or merge the pull request.

faq.question: Does this skill create the pull request for me?
faq.answer: No. It creates the commit message, pull request title, and pull request body text.

faq.question: Does it read my repository changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses local git commands to inspect branch information, diff summaries, and staged changes.

faq.question: Can it use my repository pull request template?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks common GitHub template paths and fills the template when one is present.

faq.question: How does it handle Jira tickets?
faq.answer: It uses the JIRA_TICKET environment value only when the template includes a Jira ticket section.

faq.question: Will it preserve checklist items?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the assistant to preserve all template checkbox items and mark only applicable items.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
